title: Commission Interpretative Guidelines (C/2024/5687), section 4.3.1: when the right to care ends
source: Commission Notice, Interpretative Guidelines on Regulation (EC) No 261/2004 (C/2024/5687), 25 September 2024, section 4.3.1
excerpt: the right to care subsists only as long as passengers have to wait for re-routing, under comparable transport conditions, to their final destination at the earliest opportunity (Article 8(1), point (b)), or a return flight (Article 8(1), point (a), second indent).
summary: Care lasts only while passengers wait for re-routing at the earliest opportunity or a return flight, so it ends once a passenger takes a refund without a return flight or chooses re-routing at a later date.
notes: Commission guidance, not binding law. These 2024 guidelines replace the 2016 guidelines (2016/C 214/04) named in docs/SPEC.md 5.6. Kind GUIDANCE is an addition to the SPEC 6.1 kinds; the AI may not cite it.
